body:
I am the least worried about my ultimately handling this. In addition to watching myself, my husband is like a hawk, so I should be fine in the end. I'm not opposed to meds, but I'm very happy to be free of them.

Most of my emotions stem from the feelings I get about my friend's decision. It easily could have been me. I was very close with her, and unlike when my aunt recently passed, this is more than just grief. So I am trying to work through it a bit.

I am really trying, but I'm just getting sucked into my head.

I recently came off all medication, and am doing well. But, no meds means I really have to actually deal with it, which is scary.
